verses.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
We always thank God for all of you and mention you in our prayers.
We remember your work produced by faith, your labor motivated by love, and your endurance grounded in hope in our Lord Jesus Christ before our God and Father.
Brothers and sisters loved by God, we know that he has chosen you.
Our Good News came to you not just in words but with power, with the Holy Spirit, and with deep conviction. You know how we lived among you for your sake.
You became imitators of us and of the Lord. Though you suffered greatly, you welcomed the message with the joy the Holy Spirit gives.
So you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
The Lord's message rang out from you—not only through Macedonia and Achaia, but everywhere people have heard about your faith in God. We don't need to say anything more.
People everywhere tell how you welcomed us and how you turned from idols to serve the living and true God
and to wait for his Son to come from heaven. God raised Jesus from the dead, and he rescues us from the coming judgment.
